# Chart

Figma: [04k. Chart](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=4092-137978) · Family: 04 Data Display · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-07-15

Safqah green data-visualisation foundation - Tufte-clean, full RTL + LTR, code-rendered (Recharts / D3). Figma holds the language, tokens, chrome and interaction spec; the charts themselves render from data in code.

### Chart / Gridlines

Background gridlines for a plot area (horizontal or vertical, sparse or default density) drawn in the neutral border/subtle token so they recede behind data. Semantic tokens only, green-first palette, Western numerals, time axis left to right even in RTL.

Level: atom · Part of: Chart / ChartContainer

Use when:
- Value gridlines behind bar, line or area plots
- Sparse density on mobile or small cards

Don't use when:
- Highlighting a target or average value: use Chart / ReferenceLine
- Hover guides: use Chart / CrosshairGuide

Accessibility: Decorative; aria-hidden.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | horizontal, vertical | horizontal |
| Density | `density` | variant | sparse, default | sparse |

### Chart / Axis

X or Y axis with ticks and labels in neutral tokens, with full, abbreviated or rotated label behavior; in RTL the y-axis moves right while time still runs left to right. Semantic tokens only, green-first palette, Western numerals, time axis left to right even in RTL.

Level: atom · Part of: Chart / ChartContainer

Use when:
- Time axis of a returns or payout chart (Orientation=x)
- Value axis with abbreviated labels such as 25k, 50k (Orientation=y)
- Rotated labels when category names are long

Don't use when:
- Highlighting the hovered tick: use Chart / AxisTickActive
- Sparklines in KPI rows: omit axes and use Chart / Sparkline

Accessibility: Axis labels must also exist in the data table or summary offered to screen readers; Western digits.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |
| Orientation | `orientation` | variant | x, y | x |
| LabelBehavior | `labelBehavior` | variant | full, abbreviated, rotated | full |

### Chart / ReferenceLine

Horizontal or vertical solid or dashed line marking a meaningful value such as a target return, average, or today. Semantic tokens only, green-first palette, Western numerals, time axis left to right even in RTL.

Level: atom · Part of: Chart / ChartContainer

Use when:
- Target funding amount or expected return line on a chart
- Zero baseline in a gain/loss chart
- A vertical line marking today or maturity date

Don't use when:
- General background grid: use Chart / Gridlines
- Hover guides: use Chart / CrosshairGuide or Chart / Crosshair

Accessibility: Label the line in text (Target 12%); do not rely on dash style alone.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |
| Orientation | `orientation` | variant | h, v | h |
| Style | `style` | variant | solid, dashed | solid |

### Chart / Crosshair

Crosshair overlay on x, y or both axes showing the pointer position across the plot. Semantic tokens only, green-first palette, Western numerals, time axis left to right even in RTL.

Level: atom · Part of: Chart / ChartContainer

Use when:
- Precise reading of price or value charts such as Candlestick on desktop
- Dense scatter plots where both axes matter

Don't use when:
- Standard hover on one point: use Chart / HoverIndicator
- Static reference values: use Chart / ReferenceLine

Accessibility: Pointer-only aid; provide keyboard point navigation with announced values.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |
| Axis | `axis` | variant | x, y, both | x |

### Chart / Legend

Series key with color swatches and labels, horizontal or vertical, mirrored in RTL; hidden series appear struck through. Semantic tokens only, green-first palette, Western numerals, time axis left to right even in RTL.

Level: molecule · Part of: Chart / ChartContainer

Use when:
- Multi-series charts such as revenue, costs, profit
- Stacked or donut charts where segments need names

Don't use when:
- Single-series charts: label the chart title instead
- Donut with exact values: use a labelled list (Chart / Donut shows values)

Accessibility: Legend items are text; if they toggle series they must be buttons with pressed state.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |
| Orientation | `orientation` | variant | horizontal, vertical | horizontal |

### Chart / ChartTooltip

Hover readout card for charts showing period, series swatch, value and Riyal icon, in single or multi-series mode with an optional Total (الإجمالي) row. Semantic tokens only, green-first palette, Western numerals, time axis left to right even in RTL.

Level: molecule · Part of: Chart / HoverIndicator, Chart / ChartContainer

Use when:
- Hovering a point in a returns line chart (Mode=single)
- Group hover in stacked or multi-series charts (Mode=multi-series, ShowTotal=true)

Don't use when:
- Explaining a UI term: use Tooltip
- Interactive panels: use Popover

Accessibility: Values announced via live region or focusable points; Western digits and Riyal icon labelled as SAR.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |
| Mode | `mode` | variant | single, multi-series | single |
| ShowTotal | `showTotal` | variant | true, false | true |

### Chart / ChartContainer

Chart card shell with title, subtitle, period selector, plot area and legend, with booleans to toggle grid, axis, legend, tooltip and data labels; comfortable or compact density. Semantic tokens only, green-first palette, Western numerals, time axis left to right even in RTL.

Level: molecule · Contains: Chart / Gridlines, Chart / Axis, Chart / Legend, Chart / ChartTooltip

Use when:
- Wrapping any chart in a dashboard or portfolio card
- Compact density in a back-office grid of charts

Don't use when:
- A single headline number without plot: use Stat
- Loading, empty or error state of a chart card: use Chart / States

Accessibility: Title as heading; provide a text summary or data table alternative for the plotted data.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| showGrid | `showGrid` | boolean |  | true |
| showAxis | `showAxis` | boolean |  | true |
| showLegend | `showLegend` | boolean |  | true |
| showTooltip | `showTooltip` | boolean |  | false |
| showDataLabels | `showDataLabels` | boolean |  | false |
| Density | `density` | variant | comfortable, compact | comfortable |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

### Chart / States

Chart card states: default, loading (grey bars plus spinner), empty (no items yet with button) and error (couldn't load chart with Retry), in LTR and RTL. Semantic tokens only, green-first palette, Western numerals, time axis left to right even in RTL.

Level: molecule · Contains: EmptyState, SpinnerRing

Use when:
- Chart data still fetching (State=loading)
- No returns or payouts yet to plot (State=empty)
- Chart request failed (State=error, Retry)

Don't use when:
- A whole page with no content: use EmptyState
- A whole page loading: use Skeleton primitives

Accessibility: Loading sets aria-busy; error text and Retry button must be reachable by keyboard.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |
| State | `state` | variant | default, loading, empty, error | default |

### Chart / Bar

Plotted bar marks only (no chrome) in vertical or horizontal layout, single, grouped, stacked or 100% stacked, in green shades. A building block that the full chart organisms compose; Semantic tokens only, green-first palette, Western numerals, time axis left to right even in RTL.

Level: atom · Part of: Chart / Bar, Chart / ChartContainer

Use when:
- Composing a custom chart inside Chart / ChartContainer when the ready Chart / Bar organism does not fit
- Showing the mark styles in specs for engineering (charts render in code with Recharts or D3)

Don't use when:
- A complete chart with axes, legend and hover: use the Chart / Bar organism (Direction x State set)
- A tiny inline trend: use Chart / Sparkline
- Categorical red/green for gain and loss: never; use vivid vs dark green

Accessibility: Decorative on its own; the chart must offer a text summary or data table.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Layout | `layout` | variant | vertical, horizontal | vertical |
| Grouping | `grouping` | variant | single, grouped, stacked, stacked100 | single |

### Chart / Sparkline

Tiny line or bar trend without axes, meant to sit next to a number to show direction over time. Semantic tokens only, green-first palette, Western numerals, time axis left to right even in RTL.

Level: atom · Part of: Chart / KPI strip, Chart / Template-Tufte-Sparkline

Use when:
- Trend next to a KPI in Chart / KPI strip or a portfolio summary
- Small trend inside a table row or list item

Don't use when:
- A chart users must read values from: use Chart / Line
- A single number with delta only: use Stat

Accessibility: Decorative; the adjacent number and delta text carry meaning.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Type | `type` | variant | line, bar | line |

### Chart / Combo

Combo marks: green bars plus a dark-green line with dots on one shared axis, for two related series. A plot-only building block; Semantic tokens only, green-first palette, Western numerals, time axis left to right even in RTL.

Level: atom · Part of: Chart / Combo

Use when:
- Monthly payouts as bars with cumulative return as a line
- Specs or custom compositions inside Chart / ChartContainer

Don't use when:
- A complete chart with axes, tooltip and states: use the Chart / Combo organism set
- Signalling losses in red: never; losses are dark green

Accessibility: Decorative alone; pair with a text summary or data table.

_No properties._

### Chart / Waterfall

Waterfall marks: start and end totals in dark green with vivid green increases and darker decreases, joined by connector lines. A plot-only building block; Semantic tokens only, green-first palette, Western numerals, time axis left to right even in RTL.

Level: atom · Part of: Chart / Waterfall

Use when:
- Breaking net return into gross profit, fees and other contributions
- Specs or custom compositions inside Chart / ChartContainer

Don't use when:

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

A complete data-visualisation system: 10 chart families, each an organism variant set, plus the chrome (axes, grid, tooltip, legend, states) and hover-interaction atoms that surround them. Everything is monochromatic Safqah green, Tufte-clean, and available desktop + mobile in both LTR and RTL.

> **Info:** Charts are data-driven and code-rendered (Recharts / D3). These components are the visual language, tokens, chrome and interaction spec - not a data plotter. Bind everything to the semantic tokens; add no new variables.

### When to use

Reach for a chart family by the question it answers; reach for a neighbour when the job is different.

- Line / Area - a value over time. Line for the trend, Area for magnitude / cumulative.
- Bar / Stacked - compare categories or parts of a whole across a few groups; Stacked for composition per group.
- Donut - share of a whole (≤6 slices). For exact values a labelled list beats the ring.
- Scatter - relationship between two measures (risk vs. return); Combo - two related series on one honest axis.
- Candlestick - OHLC price movement; Waterfall - a running total broken into contributions; KPI - headline numbers with a sparkline.

### Atomic architecture

### Atoms - hover & chrome

- HoverDot (marker) · CrosshairGuide · ValueFlag · HoverBand · AxisTickActive - the pieces shown on hover.
- Gridlines · Axis · ReferenceLine · Crosshair · AxisTickActive - the plot scaffolding (neutral tokens only).

### Molecules

- HoverIndicator (guide + marker + flag + tick) · ChartTooltip · Legend · ChartContainer · States.

### Organisms

- The 10 chart families - each composes chrome + plotted marks + a headline, as a Direction × State variant set.

### Color - green-first

Monochromatic Safqah green is the default for every chart. The series & sequential ramp is six green steps: bg/brand/lightest-hover → primary #4daa57 → darkest-pressed #1c3e20 (plus hover / pressed steps).

- Multi-hue categorical (blue · orange · brown · red · yellow) is permitted ONLY in Line & Area, where overlapping series need maximum separation.
- Finance = green shades: gain vivid #4daa57, loss dark #1c3e20 - direction is read by shade, never red.
- Chrome = neutrals: grid border/subtle · axis border/default · tick border/strong · label text/muted · plot bg/surface.

> **Info:** Semantic tokens only - no new variables and no primitive Color/* tokens. Currency uses the Syntropy “Riyal logo” icon, not ﷼ or “SAR”.

### Direction - RTL & LTR

Every chart set carries a Direction property (LTR / RTL). RTL renders Arabic in Tajawal, right-aligned, with the y-axis moved to the right and lists / legends / KPI cards mirrored.

- The time axis stays Left→Right even in RTL, and numerals stay Western (1,234) - visual change must match the data.
- Currency uses the real Syntropy “Riyal logo” icon in both directions.
Line · LTR

Line · RTL

### Interaction states

Beyond Default, every chart has a Hover and a Group-hover state, built from hover atoms and wired to the direction-matched ChartTooltip.

- Hover - a single data point: crosshair guide + active marker + value flag + active axis tick + tooltip.
- Group-hover - a cluster of points: a band + multiple markers + a multi-row tooltip with الإجمالي / Total.

### Chrome components

The shared pieces around the plot - every one carries a Direction property so it mirrors for RTL.

- ChartTooltip - Direction × Mode (single / multi) × ShowTotal; Riyal icon; RTL mirrored + Arabic.
- Legend - Direction × Orientation. States - Direction × State (default / loading / empty / error), Arabic in RTL.
- Axis · ReferenceLine · Crosshair · Gridlines · ChartContainer - all Direction-aware.

### Mobile

Each family also ships a 343-wide mobile set with the same Direction × State matrix, assembled into 375 device frames for LTR and RTL.

- Real reflow, not a shrink: narrower plot, three axis labels, stacked headers; KPI becomes a single-column list.
